purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_import_reliefs.py: native OBJ import of the PalmReliefV1 pair, material assignment, and a repeating alternating row on both long inner Heikhal walls of the combined map. Every number below is read from receipts or the frozen source manifest; nothing here claims visual acceptance.
lastKnownMapSha256Note: AGENTS.md value after the keilim move; recorded as matched/not matched only, not a guard.

source.objAdapter: Source OBJ has Y reflected and triangle winding reversed for the legacy OBJ importer (create_sanctuary_reliefs.export). The importer reflects Y back, so the imported StaticMesh must reproduce canonicalBoundsCm (local +Y is the relief front) and its front faces must point +Y. Both are verified natively.

importSettings.note: Identical to the reviewed keilim/keruvim/Aron V3 OBJ adapter path (create_heikhal_keilim.run_native, create_keruvim_study.run_native). Single-mesh OBJ: destination_name is the exact mesh name; the literal 'None' trick is only for multi-mesh FBX.

materials.rule: First candidate that exists on disk and loads as a MaterialInterface is assigned to EVERY slot of the mesh (SM_KeruvimStudyV1 lesson). Falling past the first candidate is recorded as a limitation. No material is created.

windingCheck.note: GeometryScript readback of the imported LOD0 source model (copy_mesh_from_static_mesh_v2 + get_triangle_face_normal, as Scripts/release_fix_terrain_winding.py). Needs -EnablePlugins=GeometryScripting. Local +Y is the room direction after placement (yaw 0 on the -Y wall, yaw 180 on the +Y wall).
passCriteria: signedVolumeUE > 0: divergence-theorem volume using UE face normals (cross(C-A, B-A)) is positive; every part is a closed solid, so front faces point outward and the relief front points along local +Y
informationalOnly: frontBand / backBand: triangles within planeToleranceCm of local max/min Y and how many face +Y / -Y. The bands include bevel and moulding side faces, so the fraction is recorded but not judged (first run 2026-09-07: backing 8/168, carving 235/715 while signed volumes were 54518 and 5869 cm3)

row.note: Yechezkel 41:18-20: keruvim and palms alternate along the wall. Only the palm panel exists, so palm slots and keruv slots alternate and keruv slots are left EMPTY and recorded as pending. Slot 0 is at the west (Kodesh partition) end.

veneer.note: build_sanctuary_finishes.py veneers: 0.2 cm cubes centred on the source face, so the room-facing face is 0.1 cm proud of |Y| = 500. Bounds are READ from the level, then checked against these expectations.

clearance.rule: The planned world AABB of a slot (union of both mesh local boxes, rotated by wall yaw) must not have strictly positive overlap volume with any mesh-bearing actor. Union actors in unionFolder with a verified manifest decomposition are tested against their constituent boxes (release_place_assets.py). A blocked slot is skipped and recorded; it is never force-filled.

verification.compareRule: Numeric location/rotation/scale fields and AABB corners only; str(Transform) is never compared.

limitations: Palm motif only. The two-faced keruv panels of Yechezkel 41:18-20 do not exist; their slots are left empty and recorded as pending.
120 x 260 cm module, relief profiles, base height and the alternation phase are artistic choices, not text-measured.
Cedar species follows Rashi on 41:16; the material is a flat canonical colour, not a wood texture.
Import, material assignment and placement are geometric only; no visual, lighting, LOD, performance or packaged acceptance is established.
Traces return nothing in commandlets; the row is grounded from the measured floor component bounds, not a trace.
